label: Engineering Spec
description: How it is built: the units, their invariants, their failure modes, and the contracts they own (feature.md §4). The explore skip belongs to context and the refine loop to critique, so both sit on their mounts and the state declares no transitions of its own.

inputs.returned_findings.description: What a LATER phase found wrong with this one, which is why control came back here. Absent on the way down. Shapes differ by sender — a review finding carries `severity`/`claim`/`lens`, a design finding raised by acceptance or implementation carries whatever that phase recorded — so read each entry for what it says rather than expecting one shape.
